title: Cancellation Is Not Enough: What Retries Leave Behind in an Overloaded LLM Engine
abstract: arXiv:2611.08684v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clients and proxies in front of an LLM engine retry calls that time out. After a transient overload, these retries can keep the engine from recovering even when calls arrive below its capacity. Since the engine may keep computing for clients that have left, propagating cancellation looks like the natural remedy. In this paper, we test it on vLLM with overload experiments on three open models, and with scheduler traces of one that follow each client attempt to the execution it creates in the engine. We find that with retries on, cancellation alone did not restore service in any run, and only 12-38% of the calls that arrived after the overload were delivered. The traces suggest why: retries that vLLM ran typically started prefill less than half a second before they timed out. Executions that vLLM later aborted took 79-85% of the prompt tokens it computed, and vLLM's prompt-token counter missed a third to half of all computed prompt tok

translated_title: 取消并不足够：重试在过载的LLM引擎中留下的残余问题
translated_abstract: 前端客户端和代理在LLM引擎前会对超时的调用进行重试。在瞬时过载之后，即使调用到达率低于引擎的容量，这些重试也可能使引擎无法恢复服务。由于引擎可能继续为已经离开的客户端进行计算，传播取消请求似乎是自然的补救措施。本文在vLLM上测试了这一方法，对三个开源模型进行了过载实验，并通过调度器跟踪记录来追踪每个客户端尝试在引擎中创建的执行。我们发现，在开启重试的情况下，仅靠取消操作在任何实验运行中都无法恢复服务，过载后到达的调用中只有12-38%被成功交付。跟踪记录揭示了原因：vLLM运行的重试通常在超时前不到半秒才开始预填充阶段。vLLM后来中止的执行消耗了其计算的全部提示词标记的79-85%，而且vLLM的提示词标记计数器遗漏了所有已计算提示词标记的三分之一到一半。
tldr: 研究发现，在带有重试机制的过载LLM引擎中，仅靠取消操作无法恢复服务，因为被中止的执行消耗了大量计算资源（占提示词标记的79-85%），表明需要更完善的机制来管理重试造成的资源浪费。
en_tdlr: The study finds that cancellation alone cannot restore service in an overloaded LLM engine with retries, as aborted executions consume 79-85% of computed prompt tokens, revealing the need for better mechanisms to handle resource waste caused by retries.
